Before that, everything looks healthy. template-svc turns these into 500s ('storage write failed'), which notification-svc passes on and api-gateway returns as 500s on POST /v1/notify. Only some requests fail, which matches a partial S3 error rate. The aws-sdk running out of retries (#185) and the long gateway latencies come from retries, so they are symptoms. The disk warning (#71) and the slow audit_log query (#150) are unrelated. There are no deploys, and redis, the db and the worker look healthy.
SDK retries may have added load: S3 returned 503 'reduce your request rate' and the SDK's retry quota ran out. But the first S3 500s came before any retry pressure.

verdict.recommendedAction: Check the AWS Health Dashboard for S3 in us-east-1. Until S3 recovers, make template-svc artifact writes degrade gracefully (async or best-effort, or fall back to another region or bucket) so a storage failure doesn't fail rendering. Keep SDK retries limited, with backoff and jitter, and fail fast so retries don't stack up latency.
